messages:
Tess: Idea: two-week desk-to-20 push-up challenge. daily short sets, progressive ramp, scaled options for knees/elevated. winner gets a donut & title 'Push-up Mayor'. Who's in? :pushpin: :muscle:
Arjun: In. I can do 20 strict if spaced out. Schedule?
Tess: Thinking Mon-Fri two weeks, quick check-in each morning in this thread. Suggested plan: Week1: 5 -> 8 -> 10 -> 12 -> rest, Week2: 12 -> 14 -> 16 -> 18 -> 20. Scale as needed.
Becky: I will join but i need knees push-ups. counts still count?
Tess: Absolutely. Form > ego. knee or incline variants count.
Marcus: I'm in. small suggestion: include a mobility drill after set to keep shoulders happy.
Becky: Also can we do a one-time video form check? 30s clip in DM to coach?
Arjun: I can volunteer to watch short clips and give friendly tips. No judgement.
fitness-bot: fitness-bot: I can set daily reminders at 9am Mon-Fri and log "pushup done" messages. DM me "join pushup" to opt-in automations.
kudos-bot: kudos-bot: I'll add :tada: reactions for streaks and highlight the person with most consecutive days at the end of week 2.
Tess: Tiny prize idea: donut + a handwritten "Push-up Mayor" sign taped to desk for a week. Ridiculous and motivating.
Marcus: Fine by me. i'll also bring a tiny band for warm-ups on day 1.
Becky: DMing @Arjun my form clip now. thanks for volunteering!
Arjun: got it, sending a couple micro-tips. main one: keep a straight line hip->shoulder, breathe out on the push.
Tess: Logistics: we start Monday 9am. Reply "pushup" in thread when you finish each day with variant used (e.g., "pushup - incline 12").
Becky: pushup - knees 8
Marcus: pushup - incline 10
Arjun: pushup - full 6 (rest between sets)
Tess: Day1 check. Nice work folks. See you tomorrow. Also optional leaderboard spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/pushups (mock link)
Marcus: Quick Q: travel day policy?
Tess: Travel day = 50% of scheduled count = still counts. be kind to yourself.
Becky: Also shoutout to @Arjun for tips already :clap:
Arjun: cheers. small wins. keep form safe.
kudos-bot: kudos-bot: Adding reactions for day1. Keep the streaks alive!
